name: io.github.noidium/parano1d-mcp
title: Parano1d node
description: Local Parano1d node over MCP. Read-only by default; sending needs the opt-in, capped wallet mode.

environmentVariables.name: PARANOID_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Node JSON-RPC URL. Loopback IP literals only (127.0.0.1 or [::1]); hostnames, credentials and remote hosts are refused.

environmentVariables.name: PARANOID_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode. read (default) never sends; wallet adds capped sends and other wallet writes; admin adds node stop and mining submission.

environmentVariables.name: PARANOID_MCP_MAX_SEND_MICRONOID
environmentVariables.description: Per-call cap on amount + fee in microNOID (1 NOID = 1,000,000). Unset means every spend is refused, even in wallet mode.

environmentVariables.name: PARANOID_MCP_MAX_FEE_MICRONOID
environmentVariables.description: Optional additional fee-only cap in microNOID for sends, consolidation, contract and native writes.

environmentVariables.name: PARANOID_MCP_ALLOW_RAW_INTENT
environmentVariables.description: Allow tx_submit (submit an already-signed intent) in wallet mode. Off unless set to true.

environmentVariables.name: PARANOID_MCP_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Results larger than this many bytes are replaced by a truncated summary. Minimum 1024.

environmentVariables.name: RUST_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Log filter. Logs go to stderr only; stdout is the MCP transport.
